This configuration class sets up the WebMvc-specific transport components for the MCP
server, providing Server-Sent Events (SSE) communication through Spring MVC. It is
activated when:

items.source:
The WebMvcSseServerTransport class is on the classpath (from mcp-spring-webmvc
dependency)
items.translation: WebMvcSseServerTransport 类位于类路径中（来自 mcp-spring-webmvc 依赖）。

items.source: Spring MVC's RouterFunction class is available (from spring-boot-starter-web)
items.translation: Spring MVC 的 RouterFunction 类现已可用（来自 spring-boot-starter-web）。

items.source: A WebMvcSseServerTransport bean for handling SSE communication
items.translation: 用于处理服务器发送事件（SSE）通信的 WebMvcSseServerTransport Bean。

items.source: A RouterFunction bean that sets up the SSE endpoint
items.translation: 用于设置 SSE 端点的 RouterFunction Bean
